name: Canonical Item
description: The one version of a shared metal that the pack uses.

pages.title: Canonical Item
pages.text:
When several mods add the same metal, the pack picks one version as the **canonical** item. Other mods' recipes make and use it, so stacks match.\
\
Leftover items from the other mods convert 1:1 in a crafting grid, with no gain. Steel is TFMG's, bronze is Alloyed's and lead is Create Nuclear's.
